    core_dist = case['core_distance']
    distances = case['distances']

        w = max(core_dist[u], core_dist[v], d)

            u, v = v, u

            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
            x = parent[x]

        ry = find(y)
        if rx == ry:
            return False
        if rank[rx] < rank[ry]:

            total += w
            selected += 1
            if selected == target:
                break
    return {"mst_edges": mst_edges, "total_weight": total}
